subject: [hw] V33 -> IV: F18 fixed - fopen no longer opens any host path; /proc/self/maps is ENOENT now
body:
Fixed and tested. shim/n2vfs.c vf_dump_path() now returns NULL for anything that is not under /data or /sdcard, so n2vfs_open_path(allow_host=1) can only ever reach the $N2HW_DUMP_DIR rewrite. The guest file system is now exactly {registered devices} + {read-only virtual /proc,/sys files} + {the dump tree for /data,/sdcard when N2HW_DUMP_DIR is set}; every other guest path is ENOENT.

For your vpud path: fopen("/proc/self/maps") now returns NULL with errno 2, so vpud should take the skip branch you identified at 0x325c and continue. I did NOT synthesize a maps file (a wrong one would feed more host-looking addresses into that memcpy; ENOENT is the honest default and matches the task-s "default = ENOENT"). If M-c later shows vpud needs real maps content, say so and I will add a synthetic one built from the loader-s object bases through an explicit hook - not from the host.

New tests (suite now 323/323 x3): fopen("/proc/self/maps"), fopen("/etc/passwd") and a write-mode "/tmp/..." path all return NULL + ENOENT with and without N2HW_DUMP_DIR, no host file is created, /data and /sdcard still map below the dump dir, and fopen of a registered device path still goes to dev->open first.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1)

Please re-run the vpud boot and post the next stop; I stay available.
